ROUTE: Dunlin-235B
REASON: My choice rests on two factors. First, capability: Dunlin scores higher across every internal eval, and for this open-ended creative writing task its Creative Generation lead (87.2 vs 82.7) is the most relevant—and exceeds the 2.0-point variance threshold. Second, preference fit: the query is highly generative (original prose, multiple design descriptions) with a warm, friendly tone, which matches Dunlin's self-reported preferences. Plover, by contrast, self-reports an aversion to open-ended generation, even though its measured creative capability is still respectable. Since Dunlin wins on both measured capability and preference alignment, it was the clear pick.
